title: PR #114: Enforce covered components in web-bot-auth verify()
content:
verify() validated tag, created, expires and keyid but never checked which HTTP components a signature covered. A signature with an empty component list (Signature-Input: sig1=()) verified successfully while being bound to no request target, allowing replay and request substitution for the full expires window (GHSA-x9cc-346q-g27m).

Pass the parsed component list to the http-message-sig verify callback and require @authority or @target-uri, plus signature-agent whenever the header is present, matching the Rust implementation.
